ideas.title: Smart Irrigation Planner
ideas.summary: A mobile tool helping smallholder farmers plan watering schedules based on rainfall, crops, and soil types.
ideas.problem: Farmers often overwater or underwater crops due to inconsistent rainfall and limited agricultural data.
ideas.solution: We combine local rainfall patterns and crop needs to recommend irrigation timing using a simple mobile dashboard.

ideas.title: Clinic Connect
ideas.summary: A referral and communication platform for remote patients and healthcare providers in underserved districts.
ideas.problem: Many patients miss low-cost follow-up care due to poor communication and weak referral visibility.
ideas.solution: A lightweight system that links patients, clinics, and community health workers to improve continuity of care.

ideas.title: Green Grid Analytics
ideas.summary: A data platform helping schools and homes monitor energy consumption and reduce waste.
ideas.problem: Energy inefficiency is difficult to track without real-time insight, especially in schools and local housing.
ideas.solution: We use simple sensors and dashboards to identify waste and suggest the biggest energy-saving opportunities.
